proposal.rejectDialog.title: Reject Change Proposal
proposal.rejectDialog.body: The proposal becomes Rejected for all its files; the manuscript does not change. A reason helps Writing Agent do better next time.
proposal.regenerateDialog.title: Request a new Change Proposal
proposal.regenerateDialog.body: The instruction goes to the Orchestrator in the project conversation, with {{task}} as the active task. You can edit it before sending.
proposal.regenerateDialog.label: Instruction
proposal.regenerateDialog.instruction: Create the Change Proposal for {{task}} again on revision {{current}} of the manuscript. The previous proposal (base revision {{base}}) is Outdated because {{paths}} changed. Keep its purpose: {{summary}} Reuse the Task’s claims and evidence and write against the current text of the file.
proposal.regenerateDialog.notSent: The instruction was not sent and is still here.
proposal.notFound.title: Proposal not found
proposal.notFound.body: The link points to a Change Proposal that is not in this project’s manuscript.
